wholePhysicalScope: Named OpenStreetMap relation 14585092 maps both roof polygons on Salim Street, west of the industrial high school. The archive states that the museum opened at this purpose-built site in 1980.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the same mapped single-storey gallery and street-facing entrance range. Near levels resolve the sign, doors, paving and glazing.
limitations: The documented site area of about 6,000 square metres includes outdoor grounds. The building uses the two exact native roof polygons instead.
The sign is a plain identification label. Exact cladding, relief artwork, doors, parapet height, glazing and window spacing are approximate. The exterior is based on written, non-photographic facts.
The related story’s only CC0 photograph shows a different museum. That photo, restricted exterior photography, interiors and museum exhibits were excluded.
